text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: SLO breach detected for /v1/streaming generate (prod, us-east-1). p95 jumped from ~320ms to 1.2s, p99 ~8.4s over last 3m. Error budget at risk. Trigger: quant-profiles/auto-int8 rollout (canary 10%) 00:02 UTC.
Meera Patel: ack. I'm on it — Meera taking lead.
Alex Chen: grabbing traces now. Which model variant was in the canary?
Meera Patel: int8-calib-v3 -> rolled to 10% this morning around 00:00 UTC. Canary targets streaming routes.
Jamie Arroyo: seeing lots of stalled frames in the streaming workers, KV cache warmups failing then timeouts.
Elena (oncall-nyc): oncall here. Paging escalation? severity: sev2?
Meera Patel: Sev2 for now. Customer visible p99 > 5s on streaming. Not full outage but noticeable degradation and retries.
OpsBot: Escalation note created: INC-2026-1983. Oncall: Elena. Notifying SRE rotation.
Alex Chen: pulling a sample trace: requestId=abc123 -> token-gen loop waits 6s at dequantize_kv step.
Meera Patel: logs from runtime: ```
[2026-03-15T00:03:12Z] worker-7 WARN dequantize: calibration mismatch for shard 12
[2026-03-15T00:03:13Z] worker-7 ERROR stream_chunk_send: stall until kv restore
```
Samir Gupta: got it. Those dequantize warnings match the int8 calibration delta we saw in sim tests — some heads show extreme values and K/V sizes increase which triggers blocking IO.
Jamie Arroyo: hypothesis: new int8-calib-v3 uses a tighter per-head scale that increases kv size for long context, causing memory pressure and paging on NVMe attach.
Elena (oncall-nyc): can we confirm NVMe paging spikes? metrics -> storage latency?
Alex Chen: yes: disk io latency for gp2-nvme-prod spiked to 28ms avg and iops saturated on a subset of hosts at the same time as p99 spikes.
Meera Patel: immediate mitigations: 1) abort canary rollout, 2) move traffic off affected hosts, 3) fallback to fp16 profile for streaming route. Which is fastest?
Samir Gupta: abort canary via control plane -> will stop rollout but already at 10% so some pods still on int8. Hotfix: 1) pin the route to model@fp16 for all streaming service nodes (fast), 2) schedule a rollback of quant-profile in config.
Ava (Customer Success): Heads up — CS has a couple customers on streaming who reported sluggishness. We're proactively sending a note saying we're investigating.
Meera Patel: executing pin: ```redwoodctl route set /v1/streaming --model=gpt-redwood-v2@fp16 --scope=prod --force```
OpsBot: Command executed by Meera Patel at 00:06 UTC. Route config change propagated to edge in ~18s.
Alex Chen: after pin, p99 dropped from 8.4s -> 1.3s in next 45s, p95 back to ~350ms. NVMe iops falling.
Jamie Arroyo: still seeing two hosts with lingering GC stalls; cordon them and drain traffic.
Elena (oncall-nyc): cordon host-prod-7 and host-prod-14.
Meera Patel: cordoned and drained. draining logs show K/V restore completions.
Samir Gupta: urgent action: roll back int8-calib-v3 from config registry and mark profile as blocked until full regression tests. I'll create the rollback and add a block.
Samir Gupta: rollback command: ```cfgctl set quant-profile/gpt-redwood-v2 int8-calib-v3 --state=deprecated --reason="tail latency regression 2026-03-15"```
Alex Chen: added a canary-safety gate to make future calibrations require streaming bench with long-context > 2048 tokens.
Meera Patel: timeline note: 00:00 int8-calib-v3 canary start, 00:02 alerts, 00:06 route pinned to fp16, 00:07 cordons, 00:10 p99 back to acceptable.
Ava (Customer Success): sending update to affected customers: "We've mitigated the issue by routing streaming traffic to a stable profile; we'll follow up with a postmortem."
Elena (oncall-nyc): good. Assign follow-ups: Meera - write incident timeline and immediate mitigations, Samir - revert profile and add block, Jamie - verify no residual stalls and run long-context workload overnight, Alex - add additional telemetry for dequantize_kv sizes.
Meera Patel: assigned. I'll take a 15-min writeup now and hand off to postmortem doc.
Samir Gupta: created INC-2026-1983-rollback PR and added test requirements.
OpsBot: Update: paging channel will remain open for 2 hours for watch. If anything re-escalates, ping @here.
Alex Chen: quick note — we saw increased tail risk only on streaming routes (continuous chunked outputs). Batch generation routes unaffected. That narrows the optimization surface.
Jamie Arroyo: follow-up mitigation idea: add early kv size guard in runtime that rejects calibration metadata exceeding threshold and falls back to fp16 automatically. Filing ticket.
Meera Patel: thanks team. I'll post a short blameless summary in #postmortems and link the timeline. Closing the immediate page — keep on watch. :white_check_mark:
Ava (Customer Success): customers updated and CS will coordinate any follow-ups.
Elena (oncall-nyc): handing off to SRE follow-up rotation. Oncall clear for now.
incident-bot: This thread closed by Meera Patel at 00:12 UTC (manual).
